description: This file defines message structures and classes for inter-process communication (IPC) within the Thunder RPC framework. It includes classes for framing, input/output data, initialization, setup, and message types, along with utility functions and constants specific to Thunder RPC messaging.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame used for IPC, providing serialization and deserialization functionalities.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Represents input data for RPC calls, including methods to set and retrieve implementation, interface, and method identifiers.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents output data for RPC calls, including methods to add implementations and serialize data.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents initialization message data, including types of initialization and related metadata.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup message data, including configuration details such as implementation, sequence number, and categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts various incoming types to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32-bit and 64-bit systems.
